name: jankeesvw/agent-root
title: agent-root: a small script that makes a coding agent state why it needs root before Omarchy's sudo prompt
summary: Omarchy now shows which agent is asking for root; agent-root adds a bash helper plus agent instructions so the agent also says why, before you type your password.
